description: What the model catalog suite must notice: the resolver loses its exactness, stops clamping a context window, guesses between makers, ignores the endpoint, forgets that a local runtime is local, spells one model two ways, offers a level the Hub has no setting for, reads a snapshot of another format, loses the price tiers or the status of a model, lists a provider's models in the wrong order or without a limit, or relies on an alias.

mutations.name: M1
mutations.what: an id that is in the catalog as written is no longer reported as exact

patches.old: if (Object.hasOwn(providers[providerId], id)) return answer(providerId, id, providers[providerId][id], 'exact');

mutations.name: M2
mutations.what: a context window above the bound the Hub accepts is passed on as it is

mutations.name: M3
mutations.what: an unknown endpoint and an id that two makers list is answered by the first maker (a guess)

mutations.name: M4
mutations.what: the endpoint no longer says which provider a custom connection is

mutations.name: M5
mutations.what: a local runtime is looked up in the catalog like any other endpoint

mutations.name: M6
mutations.what: dots are no longer written as dashes, so "4.5" and "4-5" are two models

mutations.name: M7
mutations.what: a level the Hub has no setting for ("default") is offered

mutations.name: M8
mutations.what: a snapshot of another format is read as if it were one of the formats the Hub knows

mutations.name: M9
mutations.what: a gateway's spelling of another maker's model is no longer found through the canonical id

mutations.name: M10
mutations.what: the price tiers of a model are not reported (a long prompt would be priced at the base rates)

patches.old: rates: row[3] ? { input: row[3][0], output: row[3][1], cacheRead: row[3][2], cacheWrite: row[3][3] } : null, tiers: tiersOf(row),
patches.new: rates: row[3] ? { input: row[3][0], output: row[3][1], cacheRead: row[3][2], cacheWrite: row[3][3] } : null, tiers: [],

mutations.name: M11
mutations.what: a deprecated model is reported as a beta one

mutations.name: M12
mutations.what: a row without a canonical id (null) is read as the canonical id number null

mutations.name: M13
mutations.what: the list of a provider's models comes in the order of the file, not sorted

mutations.name: M14
mutations.what: the limit of the list of models is ignored

mutations.name: M15
mutations.what: a local runtime is given the models of some provider in the list

patches.old: if (LOCAL_PRESETS.has(presetId) || (host && LOOPBACK.has(host.replace(/:\d+$/, '')) && !provider)) return none({ local: true });

mutations.name: M16
mutations.what: a gateway's alias of a maker's model is trusted like an exact id

mutations.name: M17
mutations.what: the older context_over_200k field is no longer read as a tier

mutations.name: M18
mutations.what: the tiers of a model are kept in the order of the document, not by size

mutations.name: M19
mutations.what: a tier that is not about the size of the prompt (an output tier) is taken for a context tier

mutations.name: M20
mutations.what: the beta and deprecated bits of a status are swapped when the snapshot is built

mutations.name: M21
mutations.what: a custom connection aimed at Z.ai's own host is no longer known as Z.ai

mutations.name: M22
mutations.what: a custom connection aimed at Zhipu's host (open.bigmodel.cn) is no longer known

mutations.name: M23
mutations.what: a custom connection aimed at MiniMax's host is no longer known

mutations.name: M24
mutations.what: the GLM preset is looked up under Zhipu's (Chinese) listing instead of Z.ai's

mutations.name: M25
mutations.what: the Qwen preset is looked up under the Chinese Alibaba listing

mutations.name: M26
mutations.what: the MiniMax preset is looked up under the Chinese MiniMax listing

mutations.name: M27
mutations.what: the xAI preset has no catalog provider
